build_task_template: build a phyre task template that creates a ball rolling scenario with a table, slope, and container goal
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with randomized radius and position on a table surface
add_box_objects: add box objects like tables and covers to the phyre scene with configurable dimensions
add_convex_polygon_slope: add a convex polygon slope to the scene using converted phyre tools vertices
set_task_goal: set the task success condition requiring the ball to touch the container goal
